translations: Allah so He made them forget
puzzle.hint: Warning against forgetting Allah and the consequence of self-forgetfulness
puzzle.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
